baseObservation.meaning: immutable preimage for this semantic slice; Git/GitHub remains live-fact authority

property: Existing human decision/review/attestation owners may carry bounded operating context (intent, uncertainty, positions, constraints, handoffs, escalation, exceptions, urgency, limitations and recovery) without changing business outcome or authority and without introducing a parallel writer, store, registry or source of truth.

humanPrimitives.name: Intento operativo
humanPrimitives.question: Che cosa sta davvero cercando di ottenere la persona, distinto dall’azione dichiarata nel form?

humanPrimitives.name: Incertezza e contraddizione
humanPrimitives.question: Quali fatti sono sconosciuti, discordanti o provvisori e che cosa può essere deciso comunque?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: assenza di dato ≠ dato negativo; conflitto ≠ mediazione automatica

humanPrimitives.name: Workload, attenzione e fatica
humanPrimitives.question: La persona ha capacità cognitiva e tempo operativo sufficienti per il compito nelle condizioni reali?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: utente nominalmente autorizzato ≠ utente cognitivamente disponibile

humanPrimitives.name: Competenza e literacy
humanPrimitives.question: Il contenuto è comprensibile da chi deve agire, con differenze di esperienza, lingua e alfabetizzazione normativa/tecnica?

humanPrimitives.name: Calibrazione della fiducia
humanPrimitives.question: L’utente sa quando fidarsi, dubitare, verificare o ignorare AI, automazioni, metriche e suggerimenti?

humanPrimitives.name: Potere vs conoscenza
humanPrimitives.question: Chi conosce il fatto può essere diverso da chi può decidere; il sistema preserva entrambe le posizioni?

humanPrimitives.name: Dissenso e contestabilità
humanPrimitives.question: Interpretazioni competenti discordanti possono coesistere, essere attribuite, escalate e riesaminate?

humanPrimitives.name: Handoff e coordinamento
humanPrimitives.question: Il passaggio tra funzioni, turni, fornitori e owner trasferisce contesto, limiti, clock e responsabilità senza perdita?

humanPrimitives.name: Paura, colpa e autotutela
humanPrimitives.question: Il workflow resta utilizzabile quando una persona teme conseguenze personali, reputazionali o gerarchiche?

humanPrimitives.name: Incentivi e gaming
humanPrimitives.question: KPI, audit, deadline o reward possono essere ottimizzati senza ottenere l’esito sostanziale?

humanPrimitives.name: Scarsità e priorità
humanPrimitives.question: Budget, persone, tempo e competenze limitati sono resi espliciti senza trasformare la scarsità in giustificazione automatica?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: non fatto per scarsità ≠ non dovuto

humanPrimitives.name: Eccezioni, waiver e compensazioni
humanPrimitives.question: Deviazioni deliberate hanno owner, durata, rationale, rischio, controllo compensativo e riesame?

humanPrimitives.name: Shadow workflow e sistemi esterni
humanPrimitives.question: Decisioni nate fuori da ICTC possono essere acquisite con provenienza e limiti senza fingere completezza?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: email/meeting/Excel importato ≠ storia completa o autentica

humanPrimitives.name: Memoria, turnover e riorganizzazione
humanPrimitives.question: Cambio persona, ruolo, team, nome o struttura preserva accountability storica e ownership corrente?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: owner storico ≠ owner corrente; rename ≠ nuovo oggetto

humanPrimitives.name: Diffusione della responsabilità
humanPrimitives.question: Molti partecipanti non devono tradursi in nessun accountable owner o in responsabilità collettiva indistinta.

humanPrimitives.name: Cultura e normalizzazione della deviazione
humanPrimitives.question: Ripetute eccezioni, workaround o ritardi diventano visibili come drift, non come nuovo normale implicito.

humanPrimitives.name: Bad faith, occultamento e manipolazione
humanPrimitives.question: Il sistema distingue integrità del record da veridicità del contenuto e rende visibili conflitti/provenienza anomala.
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: record integro ≠ fatto vero; firma interna ≠ buona fede

humanPrimitives.name: Urgenza e pressione temporale
humanPrimitives.question: In crisi il sistema riduce il carico al minimo decisionale senza perdere trigger, clock, boundary ed evidenza minima.
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: UI completa ≠ UI utilizzabile sotto pressione

humanPrimitives.name: Degraded mode e dipendenze indisponibili
humanPrimitives.question: Il lavoro può proseguire con vincoli espliciti quando AI, rete, fonte, IdP, scanner, vendor o sistemi esterni sono indisponibili?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: servizio esterno down ≠ decisione impossibile o stato verde

humanPrimitives.name: Recovery, apprendimento e riapertura
humanPrimitives.question: Errore, nuova evidenza o mutato contesto possono riaprire, correggere e apprendere senza cancellare la decisione precedente?
humanPrimitives.antiCollapse: closed ≠ irreversibile; correzione ≠ riscrittura della storia

contextAxes.name: operativeIntent
contextAxes.meaning: Declared operative outcome the human is trying to achieve; never substitutes the recorded business decision.

contextAxes.name: uncertainties
contextAxes.meaning: Unknown, conflicting or provisional facts remain explicit and attributable; absence is not negative evidence.

contextAxes.name: positions
contextAxes.meaning: Attributed support, dissent, alternatives and reservations survive the final decision without acquiring decision authority.

contextAxes.name: constraints
contextAxes.meaning: Time, capacity, dependency, competence, safety, incentive and availability constraints are recorded without excusing obligations.

contextAxes.name: handoffs
contextAxes.meaning: Context can accompany responsibility transfer without turning a handoff into a new authority or complete external history.

contextAxes.name: escalation
contextAxes.meaning: Escalation state and target remain visible while the underlying decision authority stays with existing owners.

contextAxes.name: exception
contextAxes.meaning: Waivers, temporary deviations and compensating controls remain bounded, reviewable and never erase the requirement.

contextAxes.name: urgency
contextAxes.meaning: Trigger and due times are preserved under pressure; urgency never manufactures applicability or correctness.

contextAxes.name: limitations
contextAxes.meaning: Known limitations on evidence, automation and operating conditions remain visible and do not become conclusions.

contextAxes.name: recovery
contextAxes.meaning: Reopen, correction and supersession preserve prior history rather than rewriting it.

dodTemplates.GLOBAL: Preserve primitive question + antiCollapse; model evidence only, never representative-human or organizational assurance.
dodTemplates.INTERMEDIATE: At least one adverse scenario must expose removal of the primitive, including cross-role/cross-regime interactions; scenario evidence is not prevalence or legal effect.
dodTemplates.LOCAL: Absorb through the declared existing owner/mechanism path without parallel SOT; nearest falsifier before implementation; terminal only with exact-head runtime evidence.

metrics: 100% representative decisions same outcome with/without context
100% context-bearing Store mutations include decisionContextSha256 in hashed audit metadata
100% context-bearing Store mutations bind the same context digest into epistemic_step
100% instrumented decision occurrences retain context in canonical decision projection when projected
100% projected context retained in procedure trace
checklist: CL01
Context is optional; no legacy/current decision path requires it.
CL02
Context cannot change decision outcome, authorization or state transition by itself.
CL03
Unknown/conflicting facts are not normalized into false certainty.
CL04
Dissent remains attributed and visible after a final decision.
CL05
Constraints remain constraints and never excuse or delete an obligation.
CL06
Exceptions have kind, rationale and optional expiry/compensating-control references; they do not erase requirements.
CL07
Urgency preserves trigger/due ordering and does not create applicability.
CL08
Recovery references history and never rewrites predecessor decisions.
CL09
Handoff carries context but does not transfer decision authority implicitly.
CL10
Escalation status is descriptive; authority remains in existing role/policy owners.
CL11
Context text/list limits fail closed; no silent truncation.
CL12
Context is stored on existing decision occurrences where available, not in a parallel registry.
CL13
Audit event metadata binds a digest of normalized context.
CL14
Epistemic step binds the same normalized context and digest.
CL15
Canonical decision projection preserves context without minting a second decision record.
CL16
Procedure trace preserves context and audit digest without widening read scope.
CL17
Evidence/receipt semantics remain unchanged: context is not evidence sufficiency or legal conclusion.
CL18
AI cannot produce human decision authority through decision context.
CL19
No new SOT, writer, store, registry, business process or procedure is introduced.
CL20
New falsifiers are registered in the current semantic rail and repository purpose census.

mechanism.owner: existing decision/review/attestation records + Store audit/epistemic ledgers
mechanism.rejectionRule: If existing free-form fields could preserve all ten axes as structured, queryable, audit-bound semantics without overload, this value object would be removed. V4 lossless-absorption analysis rejected that collapse.

claimBoundary: Decision context is declared operating context around an existing human decision. It does not prove facts, establish legal applicability, excuse obligations, prove compliance/effectiveness, transfer authority, replace human judgement or constitute representative human/organizational evidence. Semantic mutation qualification is repository-model evidence only.
